usedFor: A “New Message” in Balsio is echoed to Telegram so people there see it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message” in Balsio, then “Reply To Message” in Telegram
bestTemplate.why: It carries each message, optionally from one thread, which is more targeted than every new thread.

watchOut: “Reply To Message” answers one specific Telegram message, so it needs that chat and message ID.
